notes:
I found three real preschool swim options in Oakville. None of the pages I read gave a class day, time or price for this fall's preschool classes, so I've left those fields out rather than guess.

```json
{
  "picks": [
    {
      "name": "Preschool swim lessons (Preschool Levels A - E), Town of Oakville",
      "age_fit": "Preschool Levels A - E. Children must be the age required for the level by the program start date. Five-year-olds don't need to finish every preschool level before moving to Swimmer.",
      "source_name": "Town of Oakville"
    },
    {
      "name": "YMCA Preschool Swim Lessons, YMCA of Oakville",
      "age_fit": "3-5 years",
      "source_name": "YMCA of Oakville"
    },
    {
      "name": "Preschool swim lessons, Goldfish Swim School Oakville",
      "age_fit": "Enrollment begins at four months. Lessons run for children aged 4 months to 12 years, with preschool lessons in structured stages.",
      "source_name": "Goldfish Swim School"
    }
  ]
}
```

Notes on what the pages said:
- **Town of Oakville:**
  - The Town's Registered Programs page says 
online registration for fall programs is now open
.
  - Its booking page had said 
fall registration opens Tuesday, August 11 at 7 a.m.

  - 
Registration for non-residents opens 14 days after Oakville resident registration begins.

  - The class schedule sits behind the Town's registration booking system.
  - The preschool level names come from the Town's 2026 rates and fees document, which lists "All Preschool Levels A - E" but gave no prices I could read.
- **YMCA of Oakville:**
  - The page says 
swim lessons run in 12-week sessions with a one-week break between sessions
.
  - 
Registration is required each session for both members and non-members.

  - It mentions a new-swimmer evaluation before September 20, which has already passed.
  - It gave no preschool class times or prices.
- **Goldfish Swim School:**
  - The Goldfish page I read is a few months old.
  - It shows no class times or prices.
  - It advertises a promotion: 
prepay 6 months of lessons in August and swim free in September
. That promotion has likely ended.
